caption: The drawing features a single metallic object resembling an old-fashioned door knocker or handle, rendered in shades of dark gray and black. The object is centrally positioned within a rectangular frame that is set against a light tan or beige background. The handle is attached to a circular base at the top, from which two slightly curved arms extend downward and bend into a rounded, almost triangular form with a broad lower section. A distinct spiral detail is present at one end of the lower section. The illustration uses tonal shading to create the appearance of three-dimensionality and highlights the metallic texture. The signature "J. Staloff" appears in the bottom right corner inside the rectangular frame.
title: Door Pull and Knocker
